pins.title: Houthi projectile reported to hit Saudi Red Sea port of Jazan
pins.summary: Bloomberg reported minor damage and no injuries after Houthi forces struck Saudi Red Sea ports in retaliation for a coalition strike on Hodeidah.

pins.title: Drone reported intercepted near Jeddah Islamic Port
pins.summary: Saudi Arabia said a drone was intercepted near the Red Sea port amid escalating Saudi-Houthi strikes. The Houthis have threatened all Saudi Red Sea ports.

pins.title: Saudi-led coalition reported striking Hodeidah port area
pins.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it struck Hodeidah, prompting Houthi retaliation against Saudi Red Sea ports.

pins.title: IRGC reports LNG vessel fire from naval mine in Hormuz
pins.summary: Iran's IRGC said an LNG vessel caught fire after hitting a mine and claimed it downed US drones. These are Iranian claims not independently verified.

pins.title: French teams head to Israel over southern Lebanon pilot zones
pins.summary: French defense and diplomatic teams were reported heading to Israel to discuss the southern Lebanon pilot zones, which France considers not working.
